instances.claim: This tells me that the work's value is continually redefined, and then tells me the same thing twice more in different words.
instances.why: Line 16 already closes the five-transformation list with "continually redefined by decentralized consensus"; line 17 restates that as "indeterminate and continually redefined" and line 18 restates it again as "an ongoing process of redefinition" — all three sit in the same register (the status of the object's value), with the word root literally repeated, so neither 17 nor 18 adds a mechanism, an object, a reader or a form. Line 20 does earn its place, because it shifts to what kind of thing the work is and to the participants who act on it; 17 is pure summary of the list just read, and cutting it loses nothing that 16 and 18 do not already carry.
